name: Dumbbell Lateral to Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells beside your thighs, and a soft bend in your elbows.
Raise both arms out to the sides until your hands reach shoulder height.
Keep your arms at shoulder height as you sweep the dumbbells forward in front of your chest.
Lower both dumbbells slowly to the front of your thighs and return them to your sides.
tips: Keep your torso still without leaning back as your arms sweep forward.
Keep the same slight bend in your elbows as the dumbbells pass from your sides to the front.
